title: Multi-PSP Payment Routing Architecture
lesson: Never depend on a single PSP in a market where any PSP can go down on a Friday evening.

title: Event-Driven Reconciliation Pipeline
lesson: Reconciliation that runs as a background job beats cron by an order of magnitude in reliability.
description: Built a reconciliation system where every payment event (initiation, confirmation, failure) is written to an append-only events table. A background worker processes unreconciled events in batches and matches them against PSP settlement reports.

title: API Versioning Without Breaking Clients
lesson: URL versioning is blunt but reliable. Header-based versioning is elegant but fragile.
description: Evaluated three versioning strategies for the Korporty API: URL prefix (/v1/), Accept header, and custom header. Chose URL prefix for client simplicity — embedded fintech clients don't reliably set custom headers.
